text: {"lessons":["Selling a position just because it is showing a gain can cut short future upside; I should base decisions on the investment outlook, not my purchase price.","Avoiding a sale at a loss to spare myself regret can leave me holding a weak position; I should assess losses objectively.","Since past price moves do not predict future ones and I trade infrequently, I should make deliberate decisions rather than react to short-term account changes."]}
